title: SYNTHETIC molecular prediction
abstract: This synthetic study presents molecular prediction for drug discovery using graph models. The framework combines molecular descriptors with a learning approach for compound prioritization. The study evaluates prediction performance on a fictional benchmark for molecular screening.
